name: The Sky Weaver's Loom
description: A colossal mechanical loom floats among the clouds, weaving ribbons of light and starlight into the fabric of the sky itself, with tiny glowing threads forming new constellations.
prompt: A massive steampunk-style loom suspended in a bright blue sky filled with soft white clouds, weaving glowing threads of starlight and golden light into the sky, creating new constellation patterns, surrounded by floating spools of cosmic thread, intricate brass gears and pulleys, soft sunlight illuminating the scene, whimsical fantasy art style, highly detailed, cinematic lighting
caption: Weaving dreams into the dawn... ✨ What story would you write across the sky?
